description: Lists tickets that have been deleted from Zendesk, showing up to 100 deleted tickets per page with pagination. Use when you need to retrieve information about previously deleted tickets or audit ticket deletions. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing deleted tickets.

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: ?page=2 (integer page number). Cursor: ?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Use traditional pagination (page number) or cursor-based pagination (page[size] and page[after]).
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page (max 100). Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many deleted tickets to show on each page. You can choose up to 100; smaller numbers can make pages load faster.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort_by.description: Sort field options for deleted tickets.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Choose which field to sort the deleted tickets by (e.g., when they were deleted, created, or their ID number).
sort_by.title: SortBy

sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose the direction of sorting—ascending (asc) or descending (desc)—to control how the list is ordered.
sort_order.title: SortOrder

support_type_scope.human_parameter_description: Filter by the type of support that handled the tickets: all tickets, just agent tickets, or just AI agent tickets.
support_type_scope.title: SupportTypeScope

inputSchema.title: GetDeletedTicketsRequest

name: get_deleted_tickets

requester_id.description: ID of the user who requested the ticket
requester_id.title: Requester Id

GetDeletedTicketsResponse.description: Response containing list of deleted Zendesk tickets with pagination info.

next_page.description: URL for next page of results
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for previous page of results
previous_page.title: Previous Page

GetDeletedTicketsResponse.title: GetDeletedTicketsResponse
